So I listen to Podcast Unlocked quite a bit, and these are my thoughts on this: I think that Sean Finnegan is both an idiot, and that what he said is being blown out of proportion. Ok, so first off, Sean Finnegan is a video guy. Essentially, he's the guy who sets up the cameras for the podcast videos, he captures gameplay videos (I know. Ironic), and he films a lot of like Up at Noon and their other video segments. I truly believe that he's only ever on the show when they have no one else to use. Around the time of this podcast, the show consisted of Ryan McCaffrey, Destin Legarie (who also is a bit of an idiot), Marty Sliva, and Mitch Dyer. Those 4 made up the show, and when one of them couldn't be on it, Sean would come in. So yeah, he's the guy who they say "shit, we need someone else in here..." But on to context: if I remember correctly, they were talking about PC's vs consoles, and how there's a theory that Xbox is just going to turn into an upgradable type product, where you just upgrade parts every couple of years. Finnegan is not a fan of this, and was giving reasons why he likes consoles over PC. From the context of the conversation, what it sounded like he was trying to say was that he preferred the "ready out of the box" quality of consoles over PC's, and part of that "ready out of the box" includes a piece of hardware that, out of the box, gives you the ability to record gameplay. So yes, what he was saying was incorrect, but it's one of those cases of "I see what you were going for." Anyway, I enjoy IGN's podcasts. Yes, they absolutely say shit that I disagree with, but at the end of the day, they're entertaining to listen to. Alanah Pearce just joined their show recently and I actually really enjoy hearing what she has to say. She's called Finnegan out on his bullshit multiple times, and it's SO satisfying! EDIT: Wording
